requirement.normalizedRequirement: The capacity of the air compressors must be sufficient for charging the air receivers from atmospheric to full pressure in one (1) hour, except for a ship with ice class IA Super, if its propulsion engine has to be reversed for going astern, in which case the compressor must be able to charge the receivers in half an hour.
requirement.source: Ice Class Regulations and the Application Thereof
requirement.sourceText: The capacity of the air compressors must be sufficient for charging the air receivers from atmospheric to full pressure in one (1) hour, except for a ship with ice class IA Super, if its propulsion engine has to be reversed for going astern, in which case the compressor must be able to charge the receivers in half an hour.
